# ExamGhost

> The invisible AI quiz solver that answers any question in seconds. Double-click any question on Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard or 20+ more and ExamGhost fills in the correct answer right on the page — no tab-switching, no copy-paste, screen-share safe.

## Overview
- **Product**: ExamGhost
- **Category**: Educational AI Study Extension & Quiz Solver
- **Official Website**: https://examghost.com
- **Supported Browsers**: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Arc Browser
- **Supported LMS Platforms**: Canvas Classic & New Quizzes, Blackboard Learn & Ultra, Moodle, Google Classroom, D2L Brightspace, Coursera, edX, Quizlet, McGraw-Hill Connect, Pearson MyLab
- **Community**: https://discord.gg/aCcsyKYJq4

## Core Capabilities
- **Double-Click Inline Solve**: Double-tap any question on any LMS to solve instantly in place with zero tab-switching and zero copy-pasting.
- **Snap-It Sniping & Draw to Solve (⌘+Shift+S)**: Draw a rectangle around chemistry structures, calculus equations, diagrams, or locked PDF questions for instant multimodal vision solving.
- **Three Display Modes**:
  - *Invisible*: Silent answer injection directly into the DOM with zero on-screen traces, popups, or toasts (100% screen-share safe).
  - *Stealth* (Default): Subtle micro-cursor indicator while reasoning, then seamlessly selects the answer.
  - *Explain*: Applies the answer and slides open a step-by-step reasoning drawer popover.
- **Three Answer Delivery Methods**:
  - *Auto-fill* (Default): Directly selects the correct radio button or checkbox.
  - *Highlight*: Illuminates the correct option with a subtle glow for 1–10 seconds (default 4s) so the student clicks it themselves.
  - *Clipboard*: Copies the verified answer directly to the system clipboard for typed short-answer and essay questions.
- **Privacy & Safety Architecture**:
  - Master on/off toggle via **⌘+Shift+U** (Mac) or **Ctrl+Shift+U** (Windows) — completely dormant until turned on; never runs in the background.
  - Closed-boundary Shadow DOM v1 isolation to prevent host page script inspection.
  - No account required to start (50 free questions included).

## Pricing Structure
